captions: {city} takes about {total} of rain a year, heaviest in {peak} at {peak_value}. Rain drives activity two ways: standing water left behind is where mosquitoes breed, and saturated soil pushes ants and roaches up out of the ground and toward the house.
Rain in {city}, {SS} peaks in {peak} and drops to {low_value} in {low}. A mosquito needs only days and a container of water to complete a cycle, so the wet months set the tempo for the whole season.
Rainfall in {city} totals roughly {total} a year. Wet weather floods the soil that ground-nesting colonies live in, and what comes out of it looks for the nearest dry structure.
